Launch of hLEND with Ember Protocol
New funding channel for Hilbert’s lending desk; potential to scale interest spread income.
Indicates available capital pool that could flow into hLEND, boosting AUM and revenues.
Early stage; current revenue impact small until deployment scales.
Risk controls may attract institutional capital and lower loss risk.
Provides revenue sensitivity; earnings scale with loan book size.

This is an early-stage scaling step for Hilbert’s institutional crypto credit push, connecting on-chain capital to its desk. A rapid rise in hLEND TVL and deployed loans, plus disclosed net yields and credit performance, would make this a stronger catalyst.
